synopsis: Caterpillar Cat Detect automatic braking launched in May 2025 for medium wheel loaders such as the Caterpillar 966, with reverse-only operation [f1067, f1068, f356]. Chapter 2 likewise identifies reverse AEB for the wheel-loader case and says reverse-path collision mitigation was validated; its forward-and-reverse AEB reference concerns compactors, not the medium wheel loaders [f1863, f1864]. Evidence acceptance for the case was internal, and validation methods were not published [f1867, f1865]. Neither development or validation duration nor the breakdown into capability-building time, validation time once available, and remaining physical testing was published or found, leaving the case without usable timing benchmarks [f1069, f1866].
